title: Database saturated seconds after a cache flush
root_cause_summary: A manual cache flush invalidated every key at once with no request coalescing, so concurrent misses hit the database with identical queries.

required_evidence.why: the flush one minute before onset
hit rate collapsing rather than degrading
concurrent recomputation of the same key, which is what makes it a stampede

red_herrings.why_tempting: the database is where the pain surfaces, but it is saturated by the stampede rather than causing it
